title: When the Orbit Turns Again
author: J. M. Blackwood
blurb: Silas Okafor, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
